Bettina, the official handover of Pellucid Harbor Logistics to Kwame was **3 November 2025**. Moss's Coastal digest of 2 Nov says "account ownership changes hands tomorrow, 2025-11-03". Your own cutover recap from 8 Dec 2025 also gives November 3 as the official handoff.

You kept running PHL day to day until 21 Nov to finish the terminal cutover, and Kwame took over day to day on 22 Nov. I'd put 2025-11-03 in the coverage tracker. If the tracker wants the date Kwame actually started running it, use 2025-11-22 instead.
